source_ref: OSF dqw9f (public node; API reports no node licence): Studies In Main Text/Study 2 Data and Code/Study 2 Data no ID.sav (https://osf.io/download/hymb6/, sha256 390e7966...65b27f), Supplemental Studies/Study S1c Data and Code/Study S1c Data.sav (https://osf.io/download/2knxu/, sha256 4a5debaf...d9142e) and Supplemental Studies/Study S2c Data and Code/Study S2c Data.sav (https://osf.io/download/6501f901f3dcd16832ddd406/, sha256 77e72d25...e4732e) -- SPSS variable and value labels of Cengage1-4; data/wallace_2026_mindsets.py for the code derivation. Paper: Wallace, Murphy, Hernandez-Colmenares & Fujita (2026) JPSP 130(2) 291-307, doi:10.1037/pspi0000498.
note: Level 1, both label levels read. Code derivation: item is the source column name lowercased (Cengage1..4 -> cengage1..4), a mechanical rename; exempt from Step 5b, no verification files. cengage4 exists only in Study 2. PER-STUDY VARIANTS: live cov_study 1 = Study 2 (838 ids), 4 = S1c (796), 7 = S2c (793). Each study's label names its own target (the professor / MCM Consulting and my boss / XYZ Organization and my team leader), and Study 2's cengage2 adds 'in order to learn from the professor'; following the batch_644/645 convention item_text carries each study's verbatim label prefixed 'Study 2 (cov_study = 1): ' / 'Study S1c (cov_study = 4): ' / 'Study S2c (cov_study = 7): ' and joined by ' | ' (prefixes and separator are IRW's). OPTIONS: in all three .sav files every Cengage value label is 1='1 - Strongly agree', 2..6 = bare digit, 7='7 - Strongly disagree' -- S2c is NOT reversed for this scale, the script applies no 8-resp flip here and the live table has no itemcov_recoded column. option_text ships the two anchors with the '1 - '/'7 - ' prefixes stripped; 2-6 blank. So HIGH resp = LESS engagement. Route 9 against the live table: all 10 study x item count vectors match the source cell for cell, e.g. Study 2 cengage4 85/101/130/123/146/106/147, S1c cengage1 178/140/78/85/135/128/52, S2c cengage3 162/167/141/149/67/57/50, source = live; live n = 8118 rows = 3351 + 2388 + 2379 (one Study 2 cengage2 missing). Direction cross-check: raw Cengage correlates +0.37..+0.73 with fit1 (1 = Strongly agree) in every study, and with raw belong1 -0.16..-0.48 in Study 2/S1c (belong printed 1 = not at all) but +0.58..+0.73 in S2c (belong printed 1 = extremely), so the S2c belong labels are the reversed ones and the Cengage labels are right in all three. No instructions text in any .sav or .sps; left blank. Rights: study-worded items; cengage2's 'willing to put in a great deal of effort beyond that normally expected' echoes Mowday et al.'s (1979) OCQ item 1 wording, but no restriction was located or quoted for it (silence = permission) and the items are the study's own adaptations.
public_note: The items were worded differently in the pooled studies (about a professor in Study 2, cov_study = 1; MCM Consulting in Study S1c, cov_study = 4; XYZ Organization in Study S2c, cov_study = 7), so item_text gives each study's wording labelled by study, and cengage4 was asked in Study 2 only; responses run 1 = Strongly agree to 7 = Strongly disagree, so higher values mean less engagement.
